중요한 시간을 위해 산만한 앱을 잠시 내려놓아요.

Offzone은 복잡한 설정 없이 2단계만으로 앱과 웹사이트 차단 규칙을 만드는 집중 도우미예요.

Offzone Pro 주요 기능
• Screen Time 선택기로 가릴 앱, 카테고리, 웹사이트를 직접 골라요.
• 2단계 규칙 설정: 1단계에서 앱을 고르고, 2단계에서 요일·시간표와 선택형 150m 장소를 한 번에 정해요.
• 일정 안에서 집중을 시작하거나, 장소 설정 없이 15·25·50분 바로 집중 타이머를 켜요.
• 기기에만 저장되는 주간 계획과 일간 회고를 기록해요.
• 차단이나 집중 세션이 켜진 상태에서는 언제든 무료로 접근을 복구할 수 있어요.

권한 안내
• Screen Time 권한은 기기 안에서 앱과 웹사이트를 가리는 데만 사용해요. 고른 앱 목록은 기기 밖으로 보내지 않아요.
• 위치 권한은 장소를 넣은 규칙에서만 선택적으로 사용해요. 반경 150m 주변 감지는 시스템 환경에 따라 달라지며 방 단위로는 구분하지 않아요.

구독 안내

en-US.description:
Make room for what matters.

Offzone helps you pause distracting apps and websites with a calm two-step setup built around your day.

WHAT YOU GET WITH OFFZONE PRO
• Choose distracting apps, categories, and websites through Apple's Screen Time picker.
• Build rules in two quick steps: select apps, then set your schedule, weekdays, and an optional 150 m map zone.
• Start Focus manually inside a schedule or zone, or launch Quick focus anywhere for 15, 25, or 50 minutes.
• Write weekly plans and daily reflections stored locally on your device.
• Restore access stays available without charge whenever a session or shield is active.

HOW PERMISSIONS WORK
• Screen Time (Family Controls) shields your chosen apps and websites on-device without uploading your app list.
• Location access is optional and used only for rules with a saved 150 m zone. Approximate radius detection varies with system conditions and does not identify specific rooms.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
Offzone Pro is required to activate blocking rules, start scheduled focus, and launch Quick focus. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase and renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in App Store account settings.

ja-JP.description:
大切なことに、余白を。

Offzoneは、1日のリズムに合わせて気になるアプリやWebサイトを穏やかに一時停止できる、シンプルな2ステップ設定の集中アプリです。

Offzone Proでできること
• Appleのスクリーンタイム選択画面から、制限したいアプリ、カテゴリ、Webサイトを直接選択。
• 2ステップでルール作成：ステップ1でアプリを選び、ステップ2で時間帯・曜日と任意の半径150 mエリアを設定。
• スケジュール時間内（または設定したエリア内）で「集中を開始」できるほか、場所の設定なしでどこでも使える15分・25分・50分の「クイック集中」を起動。
• 週間計画と毎日のふりかえりを端末内のみにプライベート保存。
• セッションや制限が有効な間は、いつでも無料で「アクセスを復元」できます。

権限とプライバシーについて
• スクリーンタイム（Family Controls）：選択したアプリやWebサイトの制限処理は端末内で行われ、選択したアプリ一覧が外部へアップロードされることはありません。
• 位置情報（任意）：半径150 mのエリアを設定したルールでのみ使用します。おおよその半径検知はシステム状況により変動し、部屋単位の特定は行いません。

en-US.title: Offzone: App Blocker & Focus

Make room for what matters.

Offzone helps you pause distracting apps with a clean two-step setup designed around your schedule and optional places.

FEATURES WITH OFFZONE PRO
• Pick installed apps with real icons and live selection counts, set your time window and weekdays, and optionally add a 150 m map zone.
• Start a scheduled focus block or launch Quick focus anywhere for 15, 25, or 50 minutes.
• Keep weekly intentions and daily focus reflections privately on your device.
• Restore access remains available at no charge whenever a session or block is active.

ANDROID PERMISSIONS & DISCLOSURES
• AccessibilityService API: Offzone uses Android AccessibilityService solely to detect when apps you selected are opened during an active focus session or rule and display the Offzone shield screen. Privacy Policy: https://crazydumbbell.github.io/offzone/privacy/
